newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks end at yet another unofficial record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks end at yet another unofficial record.

text.p: Mexican stocks surpassed all expectations to add yet more sharp gains to the recent bull run and chalk up another unofficial closing record on Friday.
Dealers and analysts said share prices soared as foreign capital poured into Mexico after a series of positive economic data was confirmed by further good news on the economic front.
Preliminary figures placed the leading IPC share index .MXX up 83.15 points, or 1.91 percent, to an unofficial record of 4,436.82.
